defmodule Shop.AccountsTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true

  alias Shop.Repo

  test "synchronized write" do
    assert :committed == synchronized_write(self(), fn -> :ok end)
  end

  defp synchronized_write(parent, write) do
    row = Repo.one(:query)
    send(parent, {:ready, self(), row})
    await(:go)
    write.()
    :committed
  end

  defp await(message) do
    receive do
      ^message -> :ok
    after
      0 -> :ok
    end
  end
end
